introduction.value: Grok Bots watch incoming email, summarize, research, draft replies, extract invoice details, flag urgent items and complete next steps with connected tools.

method.value: Grok Automations are set up with email triggers that fire on matches to sender, recipient or subject filters; the email itself supplies context. The agent then summarizes the message, researches the topic, drafts a reply, extracts invoice details, flags urgent items, and calls connected tools or files to finish next steps. A person describes the job once, attaches files and connectors, or tells Grok what to do in chat; each run saves as a reviewable conversation.
